Hasibur Rahman vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors Represented
... on 19 April, 2024 
Author: Suman Shyam
Bench: Suman Shyam
 Page No.#
Gahc010093822023
 The Gauhati High Court
 (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh)
 Case No. : Pil/31/2023
 Hasibur Rahman
 Son Of Late Hyder Rahman, Resident Of Greenland Path,
 Baghorbari, Guwahati, Kamrup Metro, Assam. 
 Versus
 1: The State Of Assam And 3 Ors Represented By The Chief
 Secretary To The Govt. Of Assam, Janata Bhawan, Dispur,
 Guwahati. 
 2:Commissioner And Secretary To The Government Of Assam
 Food And Civil Supplies Department (Food Safety).
 3:Commissioner And Secretary To The Government Of Assam
 Fishery Department.
 4:Principal Nagaon College
 Nagaon Nagaon District Assam . 
 5:THE ANDHRA PRADESH STATE FISH FARMERS ASSOCIATION  (INTERVENOR REPRESENTED BY ITS PRESIDEN For the Petitioner(s) : Ms. P. Agarwal, Advocate. 
For the Respondent(s) : Mr. K.P. Pathak, Advocate appearing on behalf of Mr. P.N.
Goswami, Additional Advocate General, Assam for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
Hasibur Rahman vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors Represented ... on 19 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13857592/
1 : Mr. S. Sarma, Senior Advocate for respondent No.4. : Mr. B.P. Borah, Advocate for the intervenor.
Page No.# 2/3 -B E F O R E - HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. VIJAY BISHNOI HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUMAN SHYAM 19.04.2024 (Vijay Bishnoi, CJ) Mr. K.P. Pathak, learned counsel appearing for the respondent State has submitted that vide Notification dated 20.01.2024, the Government of Assam, Fishery Department has published a Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for restricting import/stock/sale of fish imported from other than self sufficient States by Road/River Route using formaldehyde keeping the fish in marketable condition for long duration. It is submitted that the SOP is implemented from 20.01.2024. 
Ms. P. Agarwal, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has submitted that there are various shortcomings in the SOP and has also pointed out that there is a variation in respect of the inspections carried out by the State Public Health Laboratory; College of Fisheries; Gauhati University; Nagaon College; Dibrugarh University and the Fishery Departmental Officers at District Level in the year 2023. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that though other Agencies have found chemical formaldehyde in the fishes imported from the other States, the Fishery Department in its survey has found all the samples to be negative. It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that looking to this contradiction, it is necessary to get a report from an independent Agency other than the State Agency. 
Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and after taking into consideration the fact that the SOP is implemented from 20.01.2024, we deem it appropriate to direct the counsel for the State to furnish an affidavit in respect of Kamrup (Metro) district detailing out the action taken by the Page No.# 3/3 Fishery Department pursuant to the SOP dated 20.01.2024. The said affidavit be filed within a period of 3(three) weeks also indicating the results of the tests conducted by the Nodal Agencies designated under the SOP dated 20.01.2024 by furnishing relevant facts and figures. The affidavit be sworn by the Commissioner & Secretary of the Fishery Department,
Government of Assam. 
List again on 13.05.2024. 
 JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE Mukut Comparing Assistant Hasibur Rahman vs The State Of Assam And 3 Ors Represented ... on 19 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13857592/
